name: initialise_and_run_main_loop
description: Program entry point: it sets up several state words, copies a 3072-byte block into a working buffer, then loops, redrawing and checking game-state flags between calls to helper routines and a delay loop.

name: clear_state_and_halt
description: Clears a block of memory and a set of state words, runs several helper calls and a delay loop, then spins forever in an infinite loop so it never returns.

name: reset_colour_and_halt
description: Clears a block of memory and a set of state words, then loops forever. The facts list a colour register write, though the pseudo-code shows only the clearing and the endless loop.

name: spin_forever_stub
description: Does nothing but loop forever, so it is a dead end that never returns.

name: call_two_helpers_in_sequence
description: Calls two helper routines one after the other and then returns, with no data of its own.

name: repeat_call_while_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls two helpers, passing an argument through the address register, and keeps looping while the data-register result is non-zero.

name: poll_until_zero_result
description: Calls a helper repeatedly and stops once the short result in the data register reaches zero.

name: process_null_terminated_text
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string one byte at a time, calling a helper for each character, and returns the unchanged data-register value.

name: call_helper_until_text_end
description: Calls a helper on the current text position repeatedly until a zero byte is reached, then returns.

name: scan_text_to_terminator
description: Scans a zero-terminated text string by calling a helper at each position until the terminating zero byte, then returns.

name: draw_tile_into_four_bitplanes
description: Copies a seven-row tile from a source table into the same screen position in four bitplanes, stepping 40 bytes per row. It does nothing when the index equals 36.

name: return_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged, a trivial pass-through.

name: fatal_clear_and_halt
description: Clears a block of memory and some state words, runs helper calls and a delay, then spins forever. It is reached through a handler pointer, so it acts as a fatal halt.

name: store_handler_pointers
description: Writes the address of a handler routine into three memory slots and returns.

name: deinterleave_into_four_bitplanes
description: Takes groups of four words from a source and writes each word to its own bitplane, repeating 4000 times to fill all four planes.

name: shift_sixteen_words_into_buffer
description: Copies sixteen words from a source table into a buffer, shifting each one left by one bit. The facts also list a colour register, which the pseudo-code does not show.

name: open_dos_and_call_functions
description: Opens dos.library through exec, stores the returned library base, and then calls three further functions in that library.

name: initialise_display_and_dma
description: Sets the display window, data fetch and bitplane control registers, writes a copper list pointer, clears sprite pointers and enables DMA channels.

name: build_bitplane_pointer_table
description: Fills a four-entry table with addresses spaced 8000 bytes apart, each split into high and low words.

name: start_blitter_with_masks
description: Programs the blitter's control, mask, modulo and pointer registers, waits for the blitter to finish, then changes the interrupt enable register.

name: setup_copper_then_halt
description: Calls the blitter wait routine and four helpers while touching the copper list pointer, then loops forever without returning.

name: clear_four_longword_blocks
description: Zeroes 2000 groups of four longwords starting at the address register, clearing a 32000-byte area.

name: acknowledge_keyboard_handshake
description: Performs a keyboard handshake: it writes the keyboard serial control registers, waits briefly, then clears and sets bits to acknowledge the keyboard and set the interrupt flag.

name: update_key_state_bit
description: Derives a byte and bit position from a key code, then sets or clears that bit in a key-state table depending on the low bit of the code.

name: clear_table_bit
description: Clears one bit in a byte table, with the byte offset and bit index taken from the data registers.

name: set_four_longs_all_ones
description: Writes all-ones to four longword slots in memory.

name: test_flag_bit_inverted
description: Reads one bit from a flag table at the given index and returns all-ones when the bit is clear, or zero when it is set.

name: read_joystick_and_mouse_ports
description: Reads the mouse and joystick counter registers and the fire-button register, derives movement and button flags from them, and stores the results in memory.

name: read_extra_mouse_buttons
description: Reads the potentiometer register for the right and middle mouse buttons and stores each pressed state as a flag.

name: update_direction_debounce_state
description: Stores a new two-byte input sample, compares each byte with the previous one, and sets a countdown of 20 when the change crosses a threshold while decrementing an existing countdown.

name: store_three_helper_results
description: Calls helper routines and stores their results into three memory words.

name: copy_three_helper_results
description: Calls helper routines and stores their results into three memory words, matching the routine that shares its body.

name: clear_longword_block
description: Zeroes 8000 longwords starting at the address register, clearing a 32000-byte area.

name: allocate_memory_or_halt
description: Calls the exec memory allocator and returns on success; if the allocation gives nothing back, it spins forever.

name: spin_forever_colour_stub
description: Does nothing but loop forever. The facts list a background colour register, but the pseudo-code shows only the endless loop.

name: decode_run_length_bitplanes
description: Copies a sixteen-word header, then decodes a packed image into four planes of 8000 bytes each. A marker byte introduces a repeat run and other bytes are literal values.

name: step_through_text_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper for each character, and returns zero.

name: visit_text_characters
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper for each character, and returns zero.

name: visit_text_until_end
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper at each position until the zero byte, and returns zero.

name: visit_text_until_zero
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper per character until the zero byte, and returns zero.

name: walk_text_calling_helper
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper for each character until the zero byte, and returns zero.

name: scan_text_calling_helper
description: Scans a zero-terminated string by calling a helper at each character until the zero byte, then returns zero.

name: walk_text_until_zero_byte
description: Steps through a zero-terminated string calling a helper for each byte, and returns zero when the terminator is reached.

name: walk_text_string_bytes
description: Walks the bytes of a zero-terminated string, calling a helper for each one, and returns zero.

name: scan_text_bytes_to_zero
description: Scans bytes of a zero-terminated string through a helper until the zero byte, then returns zero.

name: walk_text_with_helper_call
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper for each character, and returns zero.

name: handle_key_press_state_machine
description: Handles one key code at a time through a small state machine: one code resets the state, two codes switch modes, and some keys set or clear a flag, save or restore two positions, or store coordinates that are read as values offset by 32.

name: save_and_invert_screen_block
description: Restores a pending saved eight-row block to the screen when one is set, then saves a new eight-row block from the screen to a buffer and inverts its pixels on the screen.

name: draw_block_to_screen
description: Copies an eight-row, four-plane block from a source buffer to the screen position computed from stored coordinates, and drops any pending saved block that sits at that spot.

name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine that returns immediately; its body does nothing.

name: merge_masked_word_into_planes
description: Clears masked bits in one word for each of four planes at the address register, then ORs in four supplied pattern words, one per plane.

name: check_flag_then_return
description: Tests a flag and a data bit and returns; the pseudo-code shows no effect beyond that check.

name: check_zero_then_return
description: Checks whether a value is zero and returns; the pseudo-code shows no other effect.

name: step_line_between_points
description: Works out the horizontal and vertical distances and their signs from four coordinates, then steps along the longer span with a 16-bit ratio, calling helpers for each step until the line is finished.

name: wait_for_cia_bit_toggles
description: Calls a library routine, then runs sixteen rounds of waiting for a bit in the CIA port register to toggle, followed by a second library call.

name: wait_cia_bits_while_forbidden
description: Disables multitasking through the exec library, runs sixteen rounds of waiting for a CIA port bit to toggle, then re-enables multitasking through the same library.

name: initialise_four_audio_channels
description: Resets four audio channel records, writes the audio channel pointer registers, clears the disk-control state, and enables the audio interrupts.

name: fill_audio_channel_record
description: Fills in a record structure from its arguments, zeroes several counters, sets a status field to one, and touches the audio control register.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a single helper routine and returns; it is a thin wrapper around that call.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, passing nothing of its own.

name: relay_to_single_callee
description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: delegate_to_single_callee
description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: forward_to_single_callee
description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: relay_to_single_callee
description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: conditionally_call_audio_helpers
description: Calls a helper and, depending on the condition flag it leaves, calls further helpers in nested steps, up to four calls in all; the facts list the four audio channel pointer registers.

name: select_audio_slot_or_fail
description: Scans four slots for one holding a positive value; if none qualifies it returns all-ones. Otherwise it sets and clears flag bits on that slot and calls a handler chosen by the low byte of the request.

name: record_audio_request_in_slot
description: Compares a 10-bit value with four stored slot values; on a match it sets a flag bit, otherwise it stores the value into a free slot, subject to a one-time guard flag.

name: update_audio_channels_per_frame
description: Runs while a sound flag is set: it counts down a timer, calls per-channel helpers for four audio channels and one final helper, then sets a flag bit.

name: step_audio_channel_sequence
description: Advances one audio channel through its sequence table: when the counter reaches zero it reads the next entry, handles loop and stop markers, then applies the entry's period and volume changes.

name: program_audio_channel_registers
description: Writes sample pointer, length and period values into the audio channel registers for two channel pairs, choosing data from a table or a default source by flag bits, then clears the channel state.

name: store_byte_at_offset
description: Stores one byte into a buffer at the offset given in the data register.

name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Mixes the current raster position counter into a three-word pseudo-random state and shifts it, producing a new value each call.

name: forward_to_single_callee
description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns straight away; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: copy_three_longs_and_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: copy_three_longs_then_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: store_three_longs_and_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: store_three_longs_then_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: copy_triple_and_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: copy_triple_then_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: store_triple_and_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: store_triple_then_count
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: copy_three_longs_into_slot
description: Copies three longwords from the source pointed to by the address register into three stored words, sets a control value, calls a helper, and increments a counter.

name: copy_three_longs_and_dispatch
description: Copies three longwords into stored words, sets a control value, then calls six helpers and increments a counter, making it the dispatching variant of the same copy.

name: update_changed_slot_values
description: When a flag is set, calls helpers to read two values; each value that differs from its previous one is stored and a status byte is set.

name: set_two_status_flags
description: Sets two status words to one and returns.

name: advance_packed_sound_event
description: Decrements a duration counter for one sound channel; when it reaches zero it reads the next packed event word, which carries a duration and a command, and updates the channel state.

name: bracket_helper_with_flag
description: Clears a status word, calls a helper, then sets the status word to one.

name: lookup_code_pair_in_table
description: Scans a table of four-byte entries backwards for a matching pair of codes; on a match it stores the entry's value in a status byte, otherwise it leaves memory unchanged.

name: return_immediately
description: Empty routine that returns immediately; its body does nothing.

name: queue_sound_sample_entries
description: Loads a series of sample addresses, lengths and channel numbers into memory, calling a helper after each entry, and finishes by storing a final entry.

name: queue_sound_sample_list
description: Loads a series of sample addresses, lengths and channel numbers into memory, calling helpers as it goes, and finishes with a final entry.

name: compute_sound_buffer_address
description: Computes a buffer address from its index argument, stores it with count and channel values, then calls a helper.

name: set_counter_then_call_helper
description: Advances a pointer slot, sets a counter to 99 and a second value to 9, then calls a helper.

name: clear_fixed_longword_buffer
description: Zeroes 8000 longwords starting at a fixed buffer address.

name: copy_buffer_run_state_loop
description: Copies 8000 longwords from one fixed buffer to another, then runs a loop of helper calls while stepping a six-state selector up and down, returning once the final state is reached.

name: draw_seven_slot_row
description: Loops over seven slots, positioning each with a spacing of 15 units and switching base offsets after the third, and calls helpers to draw the two entries of each slot.

name: pass_through_helper_result
description: Calls a helper and returns the register values unchanged, so the result passes straight through.

name: pass_through_helper_value
description: Calls a helper and returns its register values unchanged; the facts mark it as unreached padding decoded as code.

name: forward_to_helper_call
description: Thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns; the facts list three callees, though the pseudo-code shows one call.

name: store_low_byte_and_return
description: Calls a helper, stores the low byte of its result into a memory byte, and returns the value.

name: store_result_low_byte
description: Calls a helper, stores the low byte of its result into a memory byte, and returns the value.

name: record_low_byte_result
description: Calls a helper, stores the low byte of its result into a memory byte, and returns the value.

name: classify_movement_result
description: Counts down a timer; when it expires it compares two stored coordinates with the previous ones and sets a result code of one, two, four or eight depending on distance thresholds.

name: trigger_sound_slot_four
description: Sets a sound state to four, loads a parameter from a table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_sound_slot_three
description: Sets a sound state to three, loads a parameter from a table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_sound_slot_two
description: Sets a sound state to two, loads a parameter from a table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_sound_slot_one
description: Sets a sound state to one, loads a parameter from a table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_sound_slot_zero
description: Sets a sound state to zero, loads a parameter from a table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_sound_slot_five
description: Sets a sound state to five, loads a parameter from a table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: reset_status_flags
description: Sets five status bytes to zero or one, resetting a status block.

name: run_sound_state_machine
description: Advances a sound effect step by step: when its status byte is one it counts down a delay, then, depending on a state value from zero to five, calls helpers and loads timing and table values.

name: classify_secondary_movement
description: Counts down a timer; when it expires it compares two stored coordinates with the previous ones and sets a result code of one, two, four or eight depending on distance thresholds.

name: trigger_alt_sound_slot_four
description: Sets a state to four, loads a parameter from a second table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_alt_sound_slot_three
description: Sets a state to three, loads a parameter from a second table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_alt_sound_slot_two
description: Sets a state to two, loads a parameter from a second table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_alt_sound_slot_one
description: Sets a state to one, loads a parameter from a second table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_alt_sound_slot_zero
description: Sets a state to zero, loads a parameter from a second table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: trigger_alt_sound_slot_five
description: Sets a state to five, loads a parameter from a second table entry, sets two audio control values, and calls helpers to start the effect.

name: reset_alt_status_flags
description: Sets five status bytes to zero or one, resetting a second status block.

name: run_alt_sound_state_machine
description: Advances a sound effect step by step: when its status byte is one it counts down a delay, then, depending on a state value from zero to five, calls helpers and loads timing and table values.

name: place_values_in_random_slots
description: Places eight values into an eight-slot table, choosing each slot from a source value and probing forward past occupied slots.

name: write_eight_slot_bytes
description: Writes eight consecutive bytes from the stored input into a buffer, each one preceded by a helper call that uses an index stepping by two.

name: wait_until_table_value_matches
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and scans a table backwards for the value held in the status byte, returning when it is found.

name: scan_table_until_value_matches
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and scans a table backwards for the value held in the status byte, returning when it is found.

name: fill_eight_table_entries
description: Loops over eight entries, using each stored byte as an index into a table and writing a fixed value to the matching slot.

name: load_table_word_for_index
description: When the status byte is not one, loads a word from a table at an index given by the low three bits of a byte and stores it in a variable.

name: load_indexed_table_word
description: When the status byte is not one, loads a word from a table at an index given by the low three bits of a byte and stores it in a variable.

name: load_table_word_by_status

name: store_indexed_table_word

name: store_indexed_word_alt
description: When the status byte is not one, loads a word from a table at an index given by the low three bits of a byte and stores it in a second variable.

name: read_table_byte_at_offset
description: Calls a helper for an offset, reads a byte from a table at that offset into a status byte, and calls a second helper.

name: fetch_indexed_table_byte
description: Calls a helper for an offset, reads a byte from a table at that offset into a status byte, and calls a second helper.

name: lookup_indexed_status_byte

name: poll_until_status_not_three
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and reads its low two bits until they are not both set, then returns.

name: retry_masked_comparison
description: Repeatedly calls helpers, combining a stored byte with a table entry and a helper result, and loops while the status byte is at or below the masked result.

name: set_output_buffer_pointer
description: Sets an output pointer to the same global buffer whatever the index is, after checking seven even index values.

name: fill_and_shuffle_buffer_slots
description: Clears four status words, fills a twelve-byte buffer with the character code for the letter c, then places entries into free slots chosen by helper results over three passes.

name: prepare_pointer_and_call_helper

name: prepare_pointer_then_call_helper

name: select_pointer_and_call_helper

name: copy_record_fields_plus_one

name: set_status_to_constant

name: clear_status_on_table_mismatch
